_comment: MEASURED (hull.mjs --write-frame --from hull, 2026-09-29): the VISUAL HULL of the registered turnaround (subjects/transport_heli/turnaround: side / front / rear / top foregrounds, 0.05164 m voxels refined x3, 1087130 surface / shell points) projected through subjects/transport_heli/camera.json; its bbox fitted to the concept foreground bbox (s = mean of the x / y px-per-m, centres matched).
